description: This file defines the interface JournalEntryWritePlatformService for handling journal entry operations in the Fineract accounting module, including creating, reverting, and managing journal entries for loans, savings, client transactions, shares, and external owner transfers.

classes.name: JournalEntryWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing journal entries related to loans, savings, client transactions, shares, and external owner transfers in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: createJournalEntry
methods.description: Creates a journal entry based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: revertJournalEntry
methods.description: Reverts a journal entry based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoan
methods.description: Creates journal entries for a specific loan using provided accounting data.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForSavings
methods.description: Creates journal entries for savings accounts based on provided data.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForClientTransactions
methods.description: Creates journal entries for client transactions.

methods.name: defineOpeningBalance
methods.description: Defines the opening balance via a JSON command.

methods.name: createJournalEntryForReversedLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates a journal entry for a reversed loan transaction given date, transaction ID, and office ID.

methods.name: revertProvisioningJournalEntries
methods.description: Reverts provisioning journal entries for a given date, entity ID, and type.

methods.name: createProvisioningJournalEntries
methods.description: Creates provisioning journal entries based on a provisioning entry object.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForShares
methods.description: Creates journal entries related to shares.

methods.name: revertShareAccountJournalEntries
methods.description: Reverts share account journal entries for given transaction IDs and date.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates journal entries immediately for a loan transaction, with options for account transfer and loan-to-loan transfer.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForExternalOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Creates journal entries for an external owner transfer involving a loan, transfer details, and previous owner.
